name: shotstack
description: Shotstack MCP server with 23 tools: 12 reads and 11 confirmed operations.
long_description: Shared current Edit/Serve/Ingest operations with private named credentials and stage/v1 environment selection. Render, generation, account mutations and deletions require explicit confirmation. Signed upload URLs go to exclusive private files. Account and GUI outcomes remain separate from fixture/protocol validation.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute regular owner-only token file, at most 64 KB. Never bundle it.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and refuse rendering, generation, template mutations, transfers and deletions.

api_key.title: Private Shotstack API key
api_key.description: API key from your account; leave empty for token_file.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Choose stage for sandbox or v1 for production. Sandbox still charges AI generation.

allow_operations.title: Allow explicitly confirmed account operations
allow_operations.description: Allow explicitly confirmed account operations, rendering and generation.
